answer: Put every new identity through a grove probation: for its first ten epochs its rewards accrue as unvested timber that only pays out if it keeps answering fresh, unpredictable tasks itself. A Sybil operator can plant a thousand saplings, but each must survive ten epochs of real work before earning, so he fronts ten epochs of compute per fake. Accounts that go idle blow away like a dune, and their unvested timber is redistributed to active honest graders.
